scope: Closed bounded decision bundles, exact immutable policy/definition/registry identities, complete grant chains and DAG dependencies, all admitted predicates, human/field/service contexts, deny guards, exact current/future horizons and cumulative input/proof/work/output budgets. This is the reference evaluator, not the protected runtime authority service.

source_binding.interpretation: Exact working-source execution; untracked additions identified by hashes. The base commit alone does not identify the added engine.

verified_examples: Independent aggregate oracle across every two-rule effect/truth combination; complete witness order and no effect short circuit.
Four-edge delegation with exact live issuer guards and separate sensitive-field grant; proposed/original operation actor preserved.
Depth16/17, contexts128/129, pins32/33, bindings512, roles256, all65536 witnesses/rule visits, exact2MiB proof boundary and next-byte refusal, output budget exhaustion, memo eviction/recomputation.

Every ten-string service action plus completion/claim/failure terminal replay, root and child-worker lease provenance/currentness, safe fail independent of expired metadata deadline, exact journal parents and projector apply/replay commitments.

Known-empty versus unavailable group identity, exact ACL/creator slot contents, purpose/fact producer identity and future horizons, field/reference prerequisites, sensitive authority and explicit field denies.
All313 earlier unit cases, including the1024-subset compatibility oracle, remain in the415-case combined run.

preserved_history.failed_attempts: Developing schema/type errors, context fixture aliasing and unknown test-action literals, and earlier focused/fixture/accounting attempts remain private with exact original bytes. Later passes do not replace them.

independent_review.kind: Parallel automated source/protocol review, not a human security sign-off
independent_review.corrections: Group/ACL/journal-operation hash completeness, code-unit slot ordering, multi-path projection lookup, exact applied-event replay commitments, current/proposed scope-anchor provenance and every parent-scope applicability.

limitations: Canonical producer authenticity, exhaustive database discovery, caller authentication and opaque capability issuance remain unimplemented in this pure increment. Synthetic evidence is not a trusted runtime snapshot.

PostgreSQL/OpenSearch parameterized compilation and equivalence, policy/role/responsibility/group/delegation/elevation/field administration and simulator disclosure authorization remain required subsequent work.

No SQL migration, live HTTP/UI/worker switch, credential bootstrap, lease allocation history, transaction fencing, native connector privilege, database concurrency or browser behavior is executed by this pure gate.
No memory/RSS or maximum-profile runtime deadline qualification. Retained canonical byte counters and conservative fact-validation visits are not measured heap or interior loop counts.
No requirement/profile/release outcome is promoted. Existing runtime and original historical evidence keep their own source/time scope.
